description: Fetch the markdown companion documentation for one device, if present. The slug is the device's OSC prefix without the leading slash (e.g. 'ableton' for /ableton).

user_id.description: Your anonymous SynthHub id, if you kept it from an earlier session (see the server instructions). Optional.

name: get_device_docs

has_docs.description: False when no companion .md exists for the device.

markdown.description: The companion documentation, or a not-found message when has_docs is false.
